facts: Posted and last updated July 31, 2026.
Pro-D Day camp registration opens Aug. 4 for Coquitlam residents and Aug. 6 for non-residents.
General fitness and parks registration opens Aug. 11 for residents and Aug. 13 for non-residents.
Registration opens at 8:30 a.m. online, in person, and by phone at 604-927-4386.
Programs are visible online at least four days before registration begins.
The City asks residents to verify the exact address, unit number, Coquitlam spelling, and postal code in their account.
Eligible residents may receive 50 drop-in visits plus a $225 recreation credit through the financial-assistance program.
The Fall 2026 Program Guide covers registered programs from September through December.
The page links the official Fall Program Guide PDF.
Swimming registration opened July 21 for residents and July 23 for non-residents; skating opened July 28 for residents and July 30 for non-residents.
The official registration page independently lists the same Aug. 4, Aug. 6, Aug. 11, and Aug. 13 opening dates and the 8:30 a.m. opening time.
It says programs become visible online at least four days before registration day.
It links the Sign Me Up system and repeats account-address preparation guidance.
The official program page says each eligible family member receives 50 drop-in passes and a $225 credit.
It requires Coquitlam residency and income verification and provides an official application path.
Whitecaps host LAFC at BC Place on Saturday, Aug. 1, with a 4:30 p.m. Pacific kickoff.
Public gates open at 3 p.m.; the club recommends early arrival because electronic turnstiles are in use.
The ticket office is at Gate B.
The venue recommends no bag; permitted clear bags are smaller than 12 by 12 by 6 inches and one small opaque bag cannot exceed 6.5 by 8.5 inches.
Mobile tickets are required and BC Place is cashless, with a cash-to-card kiosk listed at Section 235.
Home supporter sections 201-207 and 248-254 prohibit LAFC colours and visiting-team support; affected guests may be relocated.
